title: EPO: A Unified Framework for Entropy Stability, Positivity, and Oscillation Suppression
summary: High-order finite volume and discontinuous Galerkin methods are often stabilized by separate nonlinear devices for admissibility, entropy control, and oscillation suppression. This separation hides a simple geometric fact: all three act on the same cellwise candidate state. We propose a general framework (termed EPO) unifying fully discrete entropy stability, positivity/bound preservation, and spurious oscillation elimination.
